title_en: Duplex for sale in the area of ​​Mjull Bathore in Diellon Rezidence.
description_en: Duplex for sale in the area of ​​Mjull Bathore in Diellon Rezidence. The duplex is located in one of the residences with high construction quality. It is organized: On the first floor, a sitting area, which also allows access to the yard. A separate cooking and dining area. A toilet. On the second floor: Four bedrooms. Three toilets. Extra work has been done by the current owner. A functional fireplace, high-quality electrical equipment, underfloor heating, etc. have been installed. The duplex also has three parking spaces at an extra cost. For more information, please contact us.
